Because the vine weight is recomputed from the basalt history each close, the kernel audit publishes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 8 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 39% of full weight. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
